ui.too_small: Make the window a little larger
ui.accounts.empty.title: No accounts saved yet
ui.accounts.empty.body: Save the account Claude Desktop is signed into, then add your other accounts. Switching between them never asks you to sign in again.
ui.accounts.empty.signed_out: Claude Desktop is not signed in yet. Sign in there first, then come back to save the account.
ui.add.title: Add an account
ui.add.body: Claude Desktop opens again signed out, so you can sign in with the other account. Nothing is lost: the account in use is saved first.
ui.add.done: Added {name}. Sign in to Claude Desktop with the new account.
ui.save.title: Save the signed-in account
ui.save.body: Name the account Claude Desktop is signed into, so you can switch back to it any time.
ui.save.replace.title: Replace “{name}”?
ui.save.replace.body: “{name}” holds the login of a different account. Replace it with the account Claude Desktop is signed into now?
ui.rename.title: Rename “{name}”
ui.rename.body: Only the name changes. The saved login and its chats stay as they are.
ui.rename.unsaved: “{name}” is saved at your next switch. Rename it after that.
ui.remove.title: Remove “{name}”?
ui.remove.body: Its saved login is forgotten. Its chats stay in Claude Desktop, and you can save the account again later.
ui.merge.title: Bring every chat into “{name}”?
ui.merge.body: The newest copy of each chat in your other accounts is copied here. Nothing is removed, and you can undo it in Activity.
ui.merge.nothing: “{name}” already has the newest copy of every chat.
ui.merge.no_list: “{name}” has no chat list yet. Claude Desktop makes one the first time you use its Code tab with this account.
ui.merge.pick: Bring chats into which list of “{name}”?
ui.switch.title: Switching to {name}
ui.step.wait: Waiting for Claude Desktop to close
ui.step.tray: Quit it from the tray icon: right-click the Claude icon, then Quit.
ui.run.force.title: Force Claude Desktop to close?
ui.run.force.body: Claude Desktop is ended at once, as Task Manager would. A reply it is still writing may be lost.
ui.run.busy: One moment: the change is being written. Quit once it is done.
